notes: Runtime menu, title, and message checks used one isolated headless Chrome process. Injected checks use the local ?devdata&autostart&brief-test=... hook, which calls gta2_dev_show_brief and queues original GXT keys through Hud_Brief_704. The title test uses ?mission-title-test=1975 and validates the title canvas. The Downtown, Residential, and Industrial original-phone missions were accepted through their actual gang phones, but all used QA unlock/respect and teleport assistance; these are not unassisted campaign playthroughs. Residential 6146 and Industrial 3230 are separate district-entry messages, not phone missions. The original mission/title timing, selected submenu, English fallback, pause state, and main menu were inspected. Keys 1600, 2306, 2026, 3727, and 1251 were injected and visually inspected. A Residential title key 2957 was additionally compared in English and Hebrew through the original phone/title route with QA assistance; the other 32 title keys still lack runtime visual confirmation. Screenshots are local ignored QA artifacts and are not included in the public build.
